text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} is feeding the cats one day with Tamaki.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日。{0}は、
タマキと一緒に猫にエサをあげていた。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go! I brought your food fur today.
Eat up 'til you're filled to the whiskers, my furry friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ～れ、
今日もエサを持ってきたにゃ。
みんな、
たっぷりと食べるのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Mya?
Oh, they already made off with everything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
あ、
もうエサがなくなってるのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: I guess I'll just open another can and—
text_block_list.orig_text: ここは新しい缶詰を開けて──

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Meowzer!
There's a light inside the can... Myaaaaghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃっ！？
なんにゃ、
缶詰から光が……
にゃああああああっ！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Who's hungry fur some taiyaki!
text_block_list.orig_text:
たい焼きは～、
いらんかにゃ～？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Meow-th watering taiyaki!
Come one, come all! Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
美味しい美味しいたい焼きにゃ～
よってらっしゃい、
みてらっしゃい、
にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, {0}!
Purr-fect timing. Come over here fur a sec.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、{0}！
ちょうどいいところにきたにゃ。
ほら、
ちょっと寄っていくにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyow... I need you to help me out with something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はにゃ……
{0}に頼みたいことがあるのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I want you to be the guinea pig fur tasting
my latest taiyaki creations!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしが新開発した試作品のたい焼きを食べて、
実験台になってほしいにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
One usually costs 100 yen, but they're yours fur [i]just[/i]
70 yen each. Nyow that's a bargain!
choice_data_list: Why am I paying to be your guinea pig?
text_block_list.orig_text:
一個100円のところ、
特別に一個70円でいいのにゃ。
だから頼むにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: W-well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Urghh... Look, I totally get how you're feline, {0}.
But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぐっ……
確かに、
{0}の気持ちもわかるにゃ。
でも……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm purr-ty sure they won't kill you.
So if you'll just bite the bullet and—
text_block_list.orig_text:
し、
死ぬことはないと思うにゃ。
だから大人しく実験に付き合って──

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Aren't you two purr-ecious! Welcome!
How about some taiyaki? They're 100 yen each.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
可愛い兄妹さん、
いらっしゃいにゃ。
たい焼き一個、100円だにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... We don't get much allowance...
So could you sell us half a taiyaki for this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その……
えっと……
ぼくたちお小遣いが少なくて……
これで、
たい焼き半分だけ売ってくれませんか……？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: What's this... 50 yen?

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Just 50 yen, huh...?
Hmmm. Well... wait, hold on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
50円だけかにゃ……
うーん、
それじゃあ……
でも、
にゃあ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I've got a purr-posal!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん、
思いついたにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
If you two help me out with making the taiyaki,
I'll give you some in exchange as a purr-esent!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミたちがたい焼きづくりをお手伝いしてくれたら、
バイト代代わりにたい焼きをプレゼントするにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Really? You will?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おねえちゃん……
ほんと？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm as honest as they come!
Oh also...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんにゃ、
嘘はつかないにゃ！
それと……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: *whisper, whisper*...
text_block_list.orig_text: ごにょごにょ……

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah, okay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
うん、
わかった！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
It's a deal!
Nyow then, let's start makin' that taiyaki!
text_block_list.orig_text:
交渉成立にゃ！
それじゃあ、
早速たい焼きづくり、
開始にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
The trick is to be real claw-tious in the beginning...
then at the last minute you whisk-er it away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここのコツは、
もっとこう、
しっかりと焼いて……
この部分で一気にやるのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Um... Like this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
こう……？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Purr-fect! You're a taiyaki prodigy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうにゃ！
うまいにゃ！　
たい焼きの天才にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... You're a good teacher.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
おねえちゃん、
ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Okay, the taiyaki's done!
You two know what to do nyow, don't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
これで完成にゃ！
二人とも、
やることはわかってるかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Yup, of course!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
もちろん！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Good kiddies! Here we go then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしよし、
それじゃあ、
行くにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mister!
Please buy some taiyaki. We made it ourselves!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄ちゃん！
わたしたちが作ったたい焼き、
買ってくださーい！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
These taiyaki are a mixture of my new recipes
and the children's purr-sistence and hard work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}！
この中に、
あたしの試作品と子供たちが
一生懸命作ったたい焼きが混じってるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I'll sell them to you at a su-purr-b price.
You wouldn't say nyo to the taiyaki in front of the children,
would you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これを特別セール価格で販売するにゃ。
子供たちが作ったたい焼きだったら、
目の前で食べないわけにはいかないにゃ～？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myeheheh. Nyow you'll be a good boy and become my guinea pig!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ……
大人しく
あたしの実験台になるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I'm im-purr-essed you ate all of it.
Exactly according to plan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃんと全部食べてくれたにゃ。
計画通りにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyow then, these taiyaki are for your paw-some work today.
You two eat as much as you like.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
このたい焼きは今日のバイト代にゃ。
二人で好きなだけ食べるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!
Look at all those taiyaki!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわあああああっ……！
たい焼きがいっぱいだぁ……！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Thank you, miss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
おねえちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Careful nyot to eat too much and get a tummy ache.
text_block_list.orig_text: 食べ過ぎてお腹を壊さないようににゃ。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Okay!
Thank you so much!
See you, miss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
ほんとうにありがとう！
おねえちゃん、
またね！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
What meow-velous children they are.
It was worth hiring them fur the job.
text_block_list.orig_text:
素直ないい子たちだったにゃ。
バイトをさせた甲斐があるのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Well, {0}?
How are you feeling?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、{0}。
調子の方はどうにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Some of the recipes were purr-ty ambitious.
There's one that's 30 times spicier than chili,
and another that makes you cat-atonic.
choice_data_list: To be honest, I don't want to remember any of it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
30倍激辛たい焼きとか、
しびれたい焼きとか、
意欲的な実験作もいっぱいあったんだけどにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Looks like my experiment was a failure.
Oh well, as they say, a cat in gloves catches nyo mice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
実験は失敗に終わったようにゃ。
まあ、
新商品開発には犠牲がつきものにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Still, thanks fur helping out today, {0}! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
今日は付き合ってくれてありがとにゃ、{0}♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Okay. Welcome back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさま。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Think of what you just saw as a dream of sorts.
Chances are you'll forget everything the second you wake up,
so no need to brood over it too much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたが今、見てたのは夢みたいなものよ。
目覚めたらすぐに忘れちゃうと思うし、
今はあんまり気にしなくてもいいわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm sure there were more than 10 taiyaki back there.
I'm surprised you actually ate them all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
というか、あのたい焼き
10個以上はあったと思うんだけど、
あんた、
よく食べきれたわね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Even if you did it for the kids, that was quite a feat.
I'm impressed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
子供たちのためとはいえ、
よく頑張ったわ。
褒めてあげる。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: I'm also impressed Tamaki improvised that plan on the spot.
text_block_list.orig_text: タマキもよくすぐにあんな作戦を思いついたわね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Selling... or should I say, \"persuading\" others
is one of her strong suits.
text_block_list.orig_text:
商売……
というか話の持っていき方が
うまいわよね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Be careful not to let her talk you into doing something
that gets you into trouble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたも、
いつの間にか大変なことを
引き受けさせられていないように、
気を付けるのよ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's it for today. Collect more Memory Shards,
and I'll have more dreams to show you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
今日はここまで。
もっと『記憶の欠片』を集めたら、
また『夢』を見せてあげるから。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Anyway, see you later! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね～♪

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Meowr... Nyow that was a weird dream.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
なんだか、
変な夢を見てたにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
You and I were feeding the cats, then I was engulfed
in a weird light... What was that about?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と猫にエサをあげてて、
変な光に包まれて、
何だったのかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Still... interesting. That's one paw-sible way to get you
to eat my new taiyaki prototypes... Nyot a bad idea!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
なるほど、
新商品のたい焼きを食べさせるには、
そういう手段もあるのにゃ……
いいことを知ったにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
...What?
Don't make kids do my bidding?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？
子供たちを利用するのはやめてくれ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyow why are you fur-miliar with what happened in my dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで、
あたしが見てた夢の内容を知っているにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So you're saying you saw the same dream just nyow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……にゃるほど。
{0}も同じ夢を見てた、
と。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyo matter! Soon I'll have you
eating taiyaki out of my paws!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも関係ないにゃ！　
{0}には今度いっぱい、
たい焼きを食べてもらうのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myeheh. Nyow that will be the day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ……
楽しみにしてるのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: With those words, Tamaki laughs happily.
text_block_list.orig_text: タマキはそう言って、嬉しそうに笑うのだった。
